SRC-035:R001.text: Provide a legal canonical active-parent to blocker handoff without weakening the single-DOING invariant

SRC-035:R002.text: Make the required blocker claimable while the parent remains honestly unfinished

SRC-035:R003.text: Resume the parent deterministically and atomically after the blocker reaches DONE

SRC-035:R004.text: Keep the parent BLOCKED when the blocker is failed or remains blocked

SRC-035:R005.text: Represent conditional environment absence explicitly with mechanical non-abusable evidence
